description: Native Windows screenshot and screen-recording tool with annotations, OCR, redaction, transcription and editing.
notes: The setup executable is extracted with Scoop's 7-Zip flow; the upstream NSIS installer is not run. Glint stores settings, its Library, presets and transcription models in %APPDATA%\Glint. On clean Windows installations, the Visual C++ Redistributable may be needed for whisper.cpp transcription.
